sets.cached_test_splits: every cached arrow whose basename contains 'test'

contamination.verdict: PASS: every token in the final stream comes from a document below 0.2 Jaccard against every evaluation test split and the sealed holdback. Overlapping documents are excluded and listed above by digest only; a document at or above 0.5 is also flagged as a source-split defect. The build fails closed if clean data cannot fill a budget or if any retained document reaches the discard threshold.

mixture.note: every shard repeats the same cycle, so every shard has the same exact per-source counts; the table below records them

nemotron_cc_math.result: HTTP 401 GatedRepo; no authentication token is available
nemotron_cc_math.substitute_reason: the requested bounded Nemotron sample could not be downloaded; the substitute is named explicitly with its own pinned revision, license and SHA-256

source_order.fineweb: the pinned parquet's rows in file order
source_order.math: subject files sorted by path, rows round-robined
source_order.numina: the pinned shard's rows in file order
source_order.selection: first accepted document until the exact source budget

split: no graft split; the full-distillation arm trains on every token

teacher_visibility.protocol: the teacher sees the same token ids the student trains on, in the same order, on the same batch; logits are computed online and never cached
teacher_visibility.supervised_targets: every position except the first of each 512-token training window; the scored formats put the worked solution after 'Answer:' or 'Solution:', so the teacher's distribution covers the solution tokens
